item.title: Martin Luther King, Jr. Commission Unanimously Passes Resolution Supporting Full Funding For Education Acts

item.title: State Broadband Office Launches Free Broadband Workforce Development Program
item.description: CONNECT NM News: SANTA FE — The Office of Broadband Access and Expansion (OBAE) today launched a statewide workforce development program that will offer internationally recognized certifications to prepare New Mexicans for high-paying jobs in the growing broadband industry. item.title: Fuselier: Loss And Grief For Seniors
item.description: By BOB FUSELIER Los Alamos We’ve all faced losses, whether the loss be a loved one, a career, a pet, a relationship, or way of life. As we age, we also face the loss of our health, abilities, and freedom to be independent. Eventually, we must all come to terms with the greatest loss we will ever face, our own death. item.title: NMDOT Scam Alert: New Mexico Has No Toll Roads
item.description: NMDOT News: SANTA FE —New Mexico has no toll roads, any message claiming you owe toll fees in our state is 100 percent fraudulent. The New Mexico Department of Transportation (NMDOT) officials emphasize that New Mexico does not operate any toll roads within state boundaries and will never request toll payments from residents or visitors.
